pokemon_scp.name: Electrode
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0101 is to be contained in an insulated spherical vault with shock-dampening foam and remote manipulation arms. Personnel must not approach SCP-0101 directly. All interactions must be performed via robotic systems.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0101 is a spherical organism capable of generating explosive discharges exceeding industrial-grade demolition charges. Detonations occur unpredictably and leave behind electromagnetic residue that disrupts sensors.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Extremely volatile. SCP-0101 detonates when startled, threatened, or exposed to strong electrical fields.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0101-A: SCP-0101 detonated during a routine scan, destroying two containment drones.
Addendum 0101-B: EM residue formed fractal patterns resembling branching lightning.

pokemon_scp.name: Exeggcute
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0102 is to be contained in a botanical chamber with psychic dampeners. Personnel must avoid separating SCP-0102’s cluster.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0102 consists of six linked organisms that share a collective consciousness. Psychic emissions increase when the cluster is disturbed or separated.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Anxious and reactive. Displays distress when any member of the cluster is moved.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0102-A: Separation of one unit caused a psychic pulse that disrupted nearby electronics.
Addendum 0102-B: Cluster communication appears to occur through low-frequency telepathy.

pokemon_scp.name: Exeggutor
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0103 is to be contained in a reinforced botanical dome with psychic shielding. Personnel must avoid proximity to SCP-0103’s heads.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0103 is a large plant organism with multiple sentient heads, each capable of independent psychic output. Displays rapid growth and can extend roots through reinforced flooring.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Unpredictable and loud. Heads frequently argue, producing disruptive psychic noise.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0103-A: SCP-0103’s roots breached a reinforced barrier.
Addendum 0103-B: Psychic noise caused headaches in personnel across two wings.

pokemon_scp.name: Cubone
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0104 is to be contained in a mammalian chamber with emotional support protocols. Personnel may interact with SCP-0104 under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0104 is a small mammalian organism that wears a bone helmet. Displays signs of grief and emits low-frequency cries that induce sadness in nearby personnel.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Timid and mournful. Shows attachment to familiar staff.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0104-A: SCP-0104’s cries caused emotional distress in three researchers.
Addendum 0104-B: Bone helmet shows anomalous durability.

pokemon_scp.name: Marowak
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0105 is to be contained in a reinforced combat chamber. Personnel must avoid proximity to SCP-0105’s bone club.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0105 wields a bone club capable of generating shockwaves. Displays heightened aggression and protective instincts.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Defensive and territorial. Reacts violently when threatened.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0105-A: SCP-0105 shattered a reinforced barrier with a club strike.
Addendum 0105-B: Shockwave output increases when SCP-0105 is enraged.

pokemon_scp.name: Hitmonlee
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0106 is to be contained in a titan-grade combat vault with shock-absorbent walls. Personnel must not enter without full hazard armor.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0106 possesses elastic limbs capable of extending several meters. Kicks generate force exceeding industrial machinery.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive and disciplined. Shows strategic combat awareness.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0106-A: SCP-0106’s extended kick shattered a reinforced barrier.
Addendum 0106-B: Limb elasticity increases during combat.

pokemon_scp.name: Hitmonchan
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0107 is to be contained in a reinforced combat vault with automated tranquilizer turrets. Personnel must avoid proximity to SCP-0107’s fists.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0107 can deliver punches at extreme speed, generating localized shockwaves. Fists show anomalous heat buildup during rapid strikes.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Calm but highly aggressive when provoked. Displays boxing-like combat patterns.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0107-A: SCP-0107 punched through a titanium plate.
Addendum 0107-B: Heat buildup exceeded 400°C during testing.

pokemon_scp.name: Lickitung
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0108 is to be contained in a mammalian chamber with adhesive-resistant surfaces. Personnel must avoid contact with SCP-0108’s tongue.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0108 possesses an elongated tongue with extreme adhesive strength. Saliva contains mild anesthetic compounds.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Curious and intrusive. Frequently attempts to taste objects and personnel.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0108-A: SCP-0108 adhered to a containment drone and immobilized it.
Addendum 0108-B: Saliva samples show anomalous numbing properties.

pokemon_scp.name: Koffing
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0109 is to be contained in a toxin-sealed chamber with industrial-grade ventilation. Personnel must wear full respirators.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0109 is a levitating organism filled with toxic gases. Gas emissions vary in composition and can cause nausea, paralysis, or hallucinations.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Unpredictable. Gas output increases when SCP-0109 is startled.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0109-A: SCP-0109 released a gas cloud that incapacitated two guards.
Addendum 0109-B: Gas composition shifts rapidly under stress.

pokemon_scp.name: Weezing
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0110 is to be contained in a hermetically sealed toxin vault with automated gas scrubbers. Personnel must not enter without full hazmat gear.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0110 consists of two linked toxic gas organisms capable of producing corrosive fumes and explosive gas mixtures. Gas output can fill a room within seconds.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive and unstable. Gas emissions spike unpredictably.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0110-A: SCP-0110’s fumes corroded reinforced steel supports.
Addendum 0110-B: Gas buildup caused a near-explosive event during testing.
